name: Rancho Valencia
positioning: Spanish Colonial hacienda-inspired Relais & Chateaux resort of casitas on 45 acres of gardens and citrus groves in Rancho Santa Fe, north San Diego County
best_for: Families or small groups wanting a private residence with resort access

facts.text: Rancho Valencia is a Spanish Colonial hacienda-inspired enclave in the heart of Rancho Santa Fe, in north San Diego County.
The resort sits on 45 acres of lush gardens and citrus groves.
Rancho Valencia is a Relais & Chateaux property.
Guest casitas have their own patios and fireplaces.
Fresh-squeezed orange or wellness juice is delivered each morning to the casita's private patio, which has two chaise lounges, a fireplace and a breakfast table.
The Palm suites have a sunken living room with a fireplace and vaulted ceilings.
The Spa includes the Serenity Yoga Pavilion and a Pilates studio.
The Spa Pool has private cabanas.
Daily fitness classes include yoga, Pilates, TRX, aqua and outdoor classes.
The Pony Room serves craft cocktails, tequila and fresh Coastal Ranch cuisine in a candlelit modern hacienda setting.
Callaway golf clubs are complimentary with a stay.
Guests can explore Rancho Santa Fe on resort bicycles.

highlights.text: The spa's hydrotherapy circuit includes outdoor steam, sauna, cold plunge and hand-painted tiled whirlpools with fountains.
The racquet facilities include Plexipave championship tennis courts, European red clay courts, padel courts and pickleball courts.
The Hacienda is a private adobe home with a full kitchen, wood-burning fireplaces in almost every room and three separate bedroom suites.
Casa Valencia is a five-bedroom private residence that combines Mexican-Moroccan styling with luxury.
The resort's surf school teaches beginners and intermediates at Del Mar Beach.

considerations.text: Guests must be 18 to use the fitness center and spa amenities.
The local beaches in Del Mar, Solana Beach and Cardiff are a short ride from the resort.
WhataHotel notes the secluded Rancho Santa Fe location means a car or transportation is needed to reach local attractions and beaches.
